note: WALTEUR ontology-lite — a FILE-SCALE TYPED ENTITY GLOSSARY the gates LINT against. This is NOT a second retrieval index: graphify stays the ONE retrieval brain (CLAUDE.md mandated nav order; one-brain law). The glossary's only job is to give the PRD/PLAN/ADR a shared, typed vocabulary so domain nouns mean the same thing across briefs and so ontology-lint.sh can WARN (advisory, exit 0) on a capitalized domain noun that no entity defines. Do not query it semantically; do not stand up a daemon over it; it is read flat by one zero-dep bash hook.

entities.name: WALTEUR
entities.definition: The portable, hook-backed build-engine discipline that turns an idea into the single best, evidence-backed version through a think→plan→build→review→QA→audit lifecycle.

entities.name: PRD
entities.definition: The DISCOVER-phase contract (walteur-discover): problem · JTBD · success-metric+unit · prioritized scope · NOT-doing · load-bearing assumptions. No PLAN without a validated problem.

entities.name: PLAN
entities.definition: The implementation spec derived from and citing the PRD: goals, out-of-scope, success metric, acceptance criteria, tasks. Spec drift = rewrite.

entities.name: ADR
entities.definition: An immutable record of an architecture decision: context, options considered, decision, consequences. Auto-numbered, append-only.

entities.name: Gate
entities.definition: A deterministic check that warns (advisory, exit 0) or blocks (HARD, exit 2) at a lifecycle seam, armed via detect-or-SKIP and never silent-green.

entities.name: Glossary
entities.definition: This file: the typed entity glossary the gates lint against. A shared vocabulary surface, not a retrieval index.

entities.name: Entity
entities.definition: A named, typed domain concept in the glossary: {name, type, aka, definition}. The unit ontology-lint checks references against.

entities.name: Build Contract
entities.definition: The typed intake artifact that records the promised outcome, build class, risk tier, interfaces, verification gates, and required evidence before runtime state starts.

entities.name: Gate Registry
entities.definition: The typed matrix that maps build class and risk tier to mandatory gate declarations, with gate availability and report metadata.

entities.name: Harness Loop
entities.definition: The canonical WALTEUR control loop: intake, discover, plan, build, verify, review, ship, and reflect with evidence gates between phases.

entities.name: Build Class
entities.definition: The primary type of work a WALTEUR run is shipping: software, workflow, document, data-ai, cloud-iac, or mixed.

entities.name: Evidence
entities.definition: A command output, report, screenshot, review, audit, decision, source, or manual check used to justify a gate verdict.

entities.name: STATE
entities.definition: The per-run control file that records phase, gates, evidence, budgets, blockers, known gaps, and handoff data.
